1.w: For the one directing. Of the servant of YHWH, of David. An utterance Of the transgression of the wicked [is] within my heart; there is no dread of God before his eyes.

2.w: For he is flattering to himself in his own eyes, having found his iniquity to be hated.

3.w: The words of his mouth [are] wickedness and deceit; he has ceased to be prudent and do good.

4.w: He devises iniquity upon his bed; he stands himself on a path [that is] not good; he does not reject evil.

5.w: O YHWH, Your loving devotion [is] into the heavens, Your faithfulness as far as the clouds.

6.w: Your righteousness [is] like the mountains of Might, Your ordinances the great deep; You keep safe man and beast, O YHWH.

7.w: How precious [is] Your loving devotion, O God! Even the sons of man take refuge under the shadow of Your wings.

8.w: They are filled from the fatness of Your house, and You let them drink [from] the stream of Your delights.

9.w: For with You [is] the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

10.w: Draw out Your loving devotion to those knowing You, and Your righteousness to the upright of heart.

11.w: Do not let the foot of pride come against me, and the hand of the wicked, do not let it drive me away.

12.w: There the workers of iniquity do fall! They have been cast down, and are not able to rise.
